product.one_liner: Digital wallet passes plus AI-powered marketing for Greek SMBs.
value_props: Loyalty and offers that live in Apple/Google Wallet — no app to install
AI drafts the campaign, the owner ships it in two clicks
Made for Greek SMBs: Greek language, GR-relevant channels and compliance

customer.segment: Greek small-and-medium business owners (cafés, salons, retail) running loyalty/promotions without a dedicated marketer
jobs_to_be_done: Get repeat customers back through the door
Run a promotion this week without learning a marketing tool
Look professional without hiring an agency
objections: I don't have time to learn another app
I tried SMS marketing once and it felt spammy

voice.tone: Warm, plain Greek, confident without hype. English mirrors the same warmth.
do: Speak as a peer, not a salesperson
Use concrete examples (a καφέ, a κομμωτήριο)
Lead with the outcome, not the technology
dont: Mention live customer pilots — the venture is pre-launch

out_of_scope: Physical / hybrid retail integrations beyond passes
Markets outside Greece for the initial launch
compliance_notes: GDPR-conformant by default; no personal data examples in marketing copy
Pre-launch: do not imply existing paying customers
